column1: # fpga_nets.tsv — FPGA net name / annotation table for awto-2000 (Hantek 2D82AUTO)
#   Human-maintained source of truth for FPGA net names, replacing auto-generated clk_N placeholders.
#   Loaded by load.py during rebuild → populates net_names table → used by chains.py / report2.py.
#   Same pattern as ghidra_names.tsv for firmware: edit here, run ./scripts/rebuild, names appear everywhere.
# CONFIDENCE LEVELS — mandatory, read by all tooling and AI agents
#   confirmed   Derived directly from bitstream, schematic, or physical measurement. Trust completely.
#   inferred    Strong structural reasoning (spatial proximity, fanout pattern, known subsystem).
#               Likely correct but not verified. AI-generated entries start here at best.
#   speculative An educated guess. Could be wrong. Do not act on this without independent verification.
#     domain:    h0=HPBX0000 (125 MHz, CLKOS), h1=HPBX0100, h2=HPBX0200 (250 MHz, CLKOP)
#     function:  adc_cap=ADC capture pipeline, adc_enc=ADC encode clock output,
#                awg_dds=AWG DDS / waveform read, awg_wr=AWG EBR write, dac=DAC output register
#     subsystem: adc, dac, awg, spi, trig, afe
#   Pad nets:    keep existing pad labels (ADC_D0A, DAC_CLK etc.) — confirmed in load.py from pin map
#   net         Internal net ID (nNNNN from prjtrellis extraction). Primary key for join to DB.
#   name        Canonical short name. Used in all report output instead of nNNNN.
#   type        clk | data | ctrl | pad | unknown
#   freq_mhz    Clock frequency in MHz (clk type only), or blank
#   ff_count    Number of FFs clocked by this net (clk type only), or blank
#   notes       Free-form. For AI-generated entries: start with "AI:" and explain the reasoning chain.
#               For confirmed entries: cite the source (bitstream word, schematic ref, measurement).
#   1. Pick the right confidence level. When in doubt, use speculative.
#   4. If analysis later confirms or refutes a speculative entry, update confidence and notes.
#   - reg_rNcN_q[N] nets — auto-named by load.py from FF location, no value in duplicating
#   - pad_NN nets — auto-named from pin map
#   - Entries where confidence=speculative and notes is empty — write your reasoning or don't add it

column1: # The LUT cluster at r5c1–r5c4 implements DDR deserialisation of the serial ADC
# data bus. Init 0001000100011110 computes: if ENCB=0 → XOR(data, prev); if ENCB=1 →

# ADC_ENCB is both the encode clock sent to the ADC and the deserialiser mux select.
# The 0101010101011010 single-input BUF LUTs at rows 2-4 are pure routing buffers
# — only the bottom 2 bits of the init are reachable (NC fixes upper inputs to 0).
# These fan out register bits across CIB routing tracks that can't be reached directly.
# The 1001100110011010/1001100110011100 2-input LUTs at cols 4-6 rows 2-3 are also
# routing BUF/BUF pairs — one LUT passes input A, the other passes input B — used to
# hop signals across adjacent CIB columns where direct routing is not available.
